Module: elastic_slot
Interface: input clk, rst_n; input in_valid, input out_ready, input [1:0] in_data; output in_ready, output out_valid, output [1:0] out_data
Specification: One-entry elastic ready/valid buffer, no combinational data bypass. Async active-low rst_n clears occupancy and data. While reset is low force in_ready=0, out_valid=0 and out_data=0. Otherwise in_ready = !occupied || out_ready, out_valid=occupied, out_data=stored data (zero when empty). At a rising edge use pre-edge occupied and out_ready: if in_valid && in_ready, store in_data and set occupied=1, including simultaneous consume/replace. Else if occupied && out_ready, clear occupied and stored data=0. Else retain state. Empty input acceptance is visible only after its rising edge. Under occupied && !out_ready, out_data and out_valid hold despite arbitrary changes in in_valid/in_data. in_ready may change combinationally with out_ready; it is not a Moore hold output. Producer need not hold invalid data; input data on an accepted edge is authoritative. No output consumption happens while empty.

Module: rotating_owner
Interface: input clk, rst_n; input req0, input req1, input retire; output grant0, output grant1
Specification: Two-client rotating ownership arbiter with registered one-hot grants. Async active-low rst_n clears both grants and initializes tie preference to client0. When idle before a rising edge, select a requesting client, breaking simultaneous requests by current preference. retire while idle is ignored. Once owned, hold that grant even if its request drops or the other client requests, until retire=1 at a rising edge. On retire set tie preference to the opposite of the retiring owner and immediately select among current req0/req1 using that new preference; if neither requests become idle. A retired owner can regain ownership when it is the sole requester. Preference persists through idle edges; it changes only on retire of a real owner. Both requesting with retire every edge must alternate owners after the first grant. Registered grants hold between edges; reset dominates retire and requests.

Module: elastic_slot
Interface: input clk, rst_n; input in_valid, input out_ready, input [1:0] in_data; output in_ready, output out_valid, output [1:0] out_data
Specification: One-entry elastic ready/valid buffer, no combinational data bypass. Async active-low rst_n clears occupancy and data. While reset is low force in_ready=0, out_valid=0 and out_data=0. Otherwise in_ready = !occupied || out_ready, out_valid=occupied, out_data=stored data (zero when empty). At a rising edge use pre-edge occupied and out_ready: if in_valid && in_ready, store in_data and set occupied=1, including simultaneous consume/replace. Else if occupied && out_ready, clear occupied and stored data=0. Else retain state. Empty input acceptance is visible only after its rising edge. Under occupied && !out_ready, out_data and out_valid hold despite arbitrary changes in in_valid/in_data. in_ready may change combinationally with out_ready; it is not a Moore hold output. Producer need not hold invalid data; input data on an accepted edge is authoritative. No output consumption happens while empty.

Module: rotating_owner
Interface: input clk, rst_n; input req0, input req1, input retire; output grant0, output grant1
Specification: Two-client rotating ownership arbiter with registered one-hot grants. Async active-low rst_n clears both grants and initializes tie preference to client0. When idle before a rising edge, select a requesting client, breaking simultaneous requests by current preference. retire while idle is ignored. Once owned, hold that grant even if its request drops or the other client requests, until retire=1 at a rising edge. On retire set tie preference to the opposite of the retiring owner and immediately select among current req0/req1 using that new preference; if neither requests become idle. A retired owner can regain ownership when it is the sole requester. Preference persists through idle edges; it changes only on retire of a real owner. Both requesting with retire every edge must alternate owners after the first grant. Registered grants hold between edges; reset dominates retire and requests.
